Work area vs. full screen

Work-area presets avoid taskbars, Docks and reserved regions. Screen presets use full display bounds. Offsets move a preset; custom coordinates specify the position directly. Select the target display first. Negative coordinates are normal for displays left of or above the primary display.

auto:1 chooses units based on the variable; avoid adding the same unit twice. Format pipelines run left to right and can transform numbers or shorten text. Use {= ...} for inline expressions, or start a ring expression with =.

bytes / speed add automatic byte-size or byte-rate units. kb:n, mb:n, gb:n and tb:n divide by powers of 1024 with n decimals; add the desired unit in the profile. duration / duration-long format seconds. Date/time fields support time:<date format>; time:relative formats relative time or duration.
